RY-L06-S01-A01.title: Runes
RY-L06-S01-A01.description: Entering the symbolic energetic flow of a selected rune.
RY-L06-S01-A01.effect: Intended to cultivate the quality and strength associated with that rune.

RY-L06-S01-A02.title: Rune Groups
RY-L06-S01-A02.description: Entering the symbolic flow of a group of runes.
RY-L06-S01-A02.effect: Intended to work with a broader runic direction rather than one rune.

RY-L06-S01-A03.title: Rune Combinations
RY-L06-S01-A03.effect: Intended to organise runic actions into a coherent structure.

RY-L06-S01-A04.title: Runic Planning
RY-L06-S01-A04.description: Structuring goals and tasks in relation to the runic flow.
RY-L06-S01-A04.effect: Intended to align wishes, tasks and actions.

RY-L06-S02-A01.title: Hel
RY-L06-S02-A01.description: Activation of ancestral channels, cleansing of the family-line structure and Hel protection.
RY-L06-S02-A01.effect: Intended to work with ancestral themes and a symbolic ally.

RY-L06-S02-A02.title: Svartalfheim
RY-L06-S02-A02.description: Working with accumulation, finances and power objects.
RY-L06-S02-A02.effect: Intended to strengthen material and craft-related resource.

RY-L06-S02-A03.title: Muspelheim
RY-L06-S02-A03.description: Developing creativity, working with emotions and accumulating energy.
RY-L06-S02-A03.effect: Intended to activate fiery resource and creative power.

RY-L06-S02-A04.title: Vanaheim
RY-L06-S02-A04.description: Working with people, spirits, totems and health themes.
RY-L06-S02-A04.effect: Intended to activate natural and social resources.

RY-L06-S02-A05.title: Midgard
RY-L06-S02-A05.description: Symbolic help from the gods and connection with the egregores of cities, countries and organisations.
RY-L06-S02-A05.effect: Intended to strengthen connection with the human world.

RY-L06-S02-A06.title: Jotunheim
RY-L06-S02-A06.description: Language learning and telepathy themes in the source system.
RY-L06-S02-A06.effect: Intended to broaden perception and communication.

RY-L06-S02-A07.title: Niflheim
RY-L06-S02-A07.effect: Intended to explore deep turning points and release old bonds.

RY-L06-S02-A08.title: Alfheim
RY-L06-S02-A08.description: Creating illusion and realising fantasies in the symbolic model.
RY-L06-S02-A08.effect: Intended to work with image, beauty and imagination.

RY-L06-S02-A09.title: Asgard
RY-L06-S02-A09.description: Power objects and totems associated with the gods.
RY-L06-S02-A09.effect: Intended to connect with the higher symbolic layer of the Scandinavian tradition.

RY-L06-S03-A01.title: Runic Protection
RY-L06-S03-A01.description: A protective structure based on runic flow.
RY-L06-S03-A01.effect: Intended to make the subtle-body model denser and more structured.

RY-L06-S03-A02.title: Elemental Protections
RY-L06-S03-A02.description: Protection based on Earth, Water, Fire or Air symbolism.
RY-L06-S03-A02.effect: Intended to choose a protective contour through the needed element.

RY-L06-S03-A03.title: Circle of Power
RY-L06-S03-A03.description: Formation of a protective and strengthening circle.
RY-L06-S03-A03.effect: Intended to gather and hold a coherent power structure.

RY-L06-S03-A04.title: Runic Healing
RY-L06-S03-A04.description: A healing-oriented flow based on runes.
RY-L06-S03-A04.effect: Historically described as working with restoration at a stronger level.

RY-L06-S03-A05.title: Elemental Healing
RY-L06-S03-A05.description: Healing-oriented practice through Earth, Water, Fire or Air symbolism.
RY-L06-S03-A05.effect: Intended to select an element according to the nature of the task.

RY-L06-S03-A06.title: Drápa
RY-L06-S03-A06.description: A ritual-poetic form of working with the flow.
RY-L06-S03-A06.effect: Intended to anchor intention through word and structure.

RY-L06-S03-A07.title: Mansöngur Connections
RY-L06-S03-A07.description: Working with human, business and runic connections.
RY-L06-S03-A07.effect: Intended to build contact and interaction.

RY-L06-S04-A01.title: Runes as Keys
RY-L06-S04-A01.description: Using runes as symbolic keys into flows with a selected quality.
RY-L06-S04-A01.effect: Intended to obtain information relevant to the question.

RY-L06-S04-A02.title: Decoding Runes
RY-L06-S04-A02.description: Reading the rune's internal instruction in the source method.
RY-L06-S04-A02.effect: Intended to clarify a course of action and possible event development.

RY-L06-S04-A03.title: Choosing a Path
RY-L06-S04-A03.description: Using runic information to select a direction.
RY-L06-S04-A03.effect: Intended to choose a route toward the desired result.

RY-L06-S05-A01.title: Runes, Organs and Main Meridians
RY-L06-S05-A01.description: Filling an organ or main meridian with the symbolic energy of a rune.
RY-L06-S05-A01.effect: Intended to combine runic and Eastern healing frameworks gently.

RY-L06-S05-A02.title: Rune Groups and Extraordinary Meridians
RY-L06-S05-A02.description: Filling the extraordinary meridian model with the energy of a rune group.
RY-L06-S05-A02.effect: Intended to work with a broader energetic contour.
